subject: [PATCH v2] mm/memory-tiers: reset demotion targets of nodes without memory

2026-10-21.patch_summary: The patch addresses a bug in the memory-tiers code, where demotion targets of nodes without memory are not properly reset. This causes stale entries to remain in node_demotion[nid].preferred, which can lead to incorrect behavior when a node regains memory and its targets are rebuilt. The patch resets the targets of every node, ensuring that only valid targets are used.
